name: duplicate-grant-roots
text:
A contract document declares its grants as lists of roots under `grants.read`, `grants.write`, and `grants.execute`, and `crates/contract/src/document.rs` resolves each root to its canonical path when it resolves the document. A grant list is a set. When two declared roots resolve to one canonical path, such as `/bin` and `/usr/bin` on a host where `/bin` is a symbolic link to `/usr/bin`, the resolved list holds that path once, at the position of the first root that named it. Every other root keeps its order. The fingerprint hashes the resolved document, so it covers the list that holds the path once. The section of `docs/config.md` on execution-contract construction states the rule.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/config.md: a grant list is a set: two declared roots naming one canonical path, such as /bin and /usr/bin on a merged-usr host, resolve to one grant.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: the tests of foe-contract, clippy with warnings denied on the same crates, and scripts/loc.sh.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
